question: In R1's rate model, at a fixed ladder of DNg100_L drives, which neurons become active, along which routes does the signal reach (or fail to reach) E1, E2, I1 and the front-left MNs, and where does it stop?

sources.cache: maleCNS cache (load_cache verifies the canonical source fingerprints)
sources.hash_rule: text files: sha256 after CRLF -> LF; .bin/.flys and evidence result.json: sha256 of raw bytes

model: R1's model unchanged (dng100_rate_model.Model network and W, draw, scale, simulate; b 0.03; RK45 rtol 2e-6 atol 5e-9; 1 s; onset 20 ms; window t = 250..999 ms). No drive adjustment: one fixed I_stim on DNg100_L per simulation; nothing silenced.

arms.VNCSIZE: secondary, descriptive: s = size * f / m_VNC; f from R1b's rule recomputed at run time (decodeSkel, neck plane, cable split) for descending_neuron and ascending_neuron superclasses, f = 1 for all others; m_VNC = R1b's median (must equal 507,457,760)

conditions.order: R1SIZE then VNCSIZE; within an arm, drives ascending, seeds ascending

readouts.active: R1's definition: max rate in the window > 0.01 Hz
readouts.per_simulation: recruited count; DNg100_L mean window rate and as a fraction of its rmax; active counts by hop layer from DNg100_L (unweighted, any-sign edges) and by class (dn, an, cord = vnc_* non-MN, mn = V1 front-left MNs, other); active MNs; E1/E2/I1 active, max and mean rate, and at t = 999 ms exc = b*sum(W+ r), inh = b*sum(W- r), theta, margin = exc + inh - theta, active presynaptic count and the 5 largest active contributions; max rate of each two-hop intermediate; V1 rhythmicity score and frequency of active MNs (score_rates), reported only
readouts.intermediates: neurons k with DNg100_L -> k and k -> E1, E2 or I1 (nonzero W); 11 unique (E2's only route AN19B009_R and I1's only route AN08B031_L are among E1's 11)

per_core_cell_and_arm.ENGAGED_AT_<I>: lowest ladder drive at which the cell is active in >= 8 of 16 seeds
per_core_cell_and_arm.NOT_ENGAGED_DNG100_SATURATED: never engaged and at 64,000 DNg100_L's mean window rate >= 0.9 x its rmax in >= 8 seeds

per_arm.CORE_REACHED_IN_PREPRINT_RANGE: E1, E2, I1 all engaged and the median recruited count at the highest of their three engaging drives <= 500

labels.stopping_point: for each non-engaged core cell at 64,000: median margin; intermediates active (> 0.01 Hz) in >= 8 seeds versus silent; median deepest active hop layer
labels.run_status: MAP_RECORDED if I2 and I4 pass, else INCONCLUSIVE (all data still recorded)

integrity.I1: source hashes; R1 network body-ID hash; intermediate body IDs; R1b z* = 462 and m_VNC = 507,457,760 reproduced; VNCSIZE sizes finite. Failure stops the run before any simulation.
integrity.I2_r1_reproduction: hard gate: for seeds 1-16, every entry of R1's recorded DNG100 drive history at 250, 500, 1000 or 2000 equals R1SIZE's recruited count at that seed and drive (R1 result.json, sha 24062901)
integrity.I3_tests: tests/test_dng100_recruitment_map.py passes (input decomposition equals the model RHS input; hops and intermediates; cell, arm and stopping-point labels; I2 check; expectation evaluation)
integrity.I4: 288 simulations, each with arm, drive and seed

expectations.X3: VNCSIZE engages each core cell at the same or a lower drive than R1SIZE (not engaged counts as infinite; cells not engaged in both arms are reported as vacuous)
expectations.note: recorded in the design before any R2 simulation; wrong ones are recorded as wrong

amendments_before_any_protocol_simulatio: The design listed 'the 11 E1 intermediates, AN19B009_R and AN08B031_L'; both are among E1's 11, so 11 unique intermediates are tracked.
The design's I3 included a unit test of the VNCSIZE size vector. It depends on decoding the full skeleton file, so it is checked at run time instead (I1: z* and m_VNC reproduced, sizes finite).
plumbing_disclosure: Before registration: --describe printed hashes, the network hash and the intermediates (structure only); --time-one ran one R1SIZE simulation at seed 0 (not a protocol seed), I = 64,000, and was read only for wall time (0.72 s). Its rates were not printed. The structural numbers in the design came from a read-only script over R1's network.
execution: one command (--output) runs all 288 simulations and evaluates in the same process; output opened exclusively; run once.
interpretation_limits: Isolated 2,111-neuron network (R1's); no other brain or cord input.
Reconstructed rate model (b from ratenet.js); 'active' (> 0.01 Hz) is permissive.
Drives above 2,000 lie outside anything the preprint's drive rule would select; they probe reachability, not physiology.
VNCSIZE inherits R1b's cable-length proxy for volume.
Descriptive: no controls, no rhythm verdict; the reported rhythm score is not a test.
Neural only: no body, physics or engine change; motor coordinates unchanged (20/42 admitted, +4 conditional).
